name: Aguas Buenas (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Green field with a blue triangle based on the hoist bearing a white star, like the Puerto Rican flag, overlaid by a yellow triangle whose point reaches the fly.
history: Aguas Buenas is a town and municipality in central Puerto Rico. The flag was designed by Francisco Díaz Rivera; according to Flags of the World the blue triangle stands for the Puerto Rican nationality and the yellow and green for agriculture, tropical flora and commercial and industrial development.

features.role: blue triangle at the hoist for the Puerto Rican nationality
yellow triangle reaching the fly, for agriculture and development
